```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```

```{r}
# data2 = read.csv("/Users/UChicago/CASNL/storyfest/data/pupil/3_processed/8_stack_cosine_df/stacked_events_lowpass_with_cosine.csv")

data <- read.csv("/Users/UChicago/CASNL/storyfest/data/pupil/3_processed/8_stack_cosine_df/stacked_events_lowpass_with_cosine.csv") %>%
         select(-c("event_start_sec", "event_end_sec", "event_duration_sec"))

# Drop rows where any of the relevant variables are NA
data2 <- na.omit(data[, c("subject", "group", "story", "event_num", "valence", "transcript", "mean_pupil_size", "z_pupil", "cosine_similarity")])

# toExclude <- c(1001, 1013, 1025, 1030)
# 
# data2 <- data %>%
#   dplyr::filter(!(subject %in% toExclude))

isc_df <- read.csv("/Users/UChicago/CASNL/storyfest/data/pupil/3_processed/7_isc_event/encoding/event_level_isc.csv")

data3 <- merge(data2, isc_df[, c("story", "event_num", "isc_r")],
                        by = c("story", "event_num"),
                        all.x = TRUE)

story_lengths <- data.frame(
  story = c("Pool Party", "Impatient Billionaire", "Sea Ice", "Grandfather Clocks", "Natalie Wood", "Dont Look"),
  story_length_sec = c(367, 330, 381, 535, 815, 710)  # Example values
)

data3 <- merge(data3, story_lengths, by = "story", all.x = TRUE)

num_big_events <- data.frame(
  story = c("Pool Party", "Impatient Billionaire", "Sea Ice", "Grandfather Clocks", "Natalie Wood", "Dont Look"),
  total_big_event_num = c(7, 6, 7, 10, 17, 12)  # Example values
)

data3 <- merge(data3, num_big_events, by = "story", all.x = TRUE)

num_events <- data.frame(
  story = c("Pool Party", "Impatient Billionaire", "Sea Ice", "Grandfather Clocks", "Natalie Wood", "Dont Look"),
  total_event_num = c(20, 17, 23, 29, 55, 41)  # Example values
)

data3 <- merge(data3, num_events, by = "story", all.x = TRUE)

data3$story<-as.factor(data3$story)
# data2$order<-as.factor(data2$order)
data3$valence<-as.factor(data3$valence)
data3$subject<-as.factor(data3$subject)
data3$valence <- relevel(data3$valence, ref="neutral")

mdl = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~valence + (1|subject))
summary(mdl)

mdl2 = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~valence + (1|subject) + (1|story)) #(1|event)
summary(mdl2)

mdl2_2 = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~valence + (1|subject) + (1|story) + (1|event_num))
summary(mdl2_2)

mdl2_3 = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~valence + (1|subject) + (1|story) + story_length_sec)
summary(mdl2_3)

mdl3 = lmer(data=data3, cosine_similarity~valence + (1|subject))
summary(mdl3)

mdl4 = lmer(data=data3, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl4)

mdl5 <- lmer(data = data3, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject) + (1|story))
summary(mdl5)

mdl6 = lmer(data=data3, cosine_similarity~isc_r + (1|subject))
summary(mdl6)

mdl7 = lmer(data=data3, cosine_similarity~isc_r + (1|subject) + (1|story))
summary(mdl7)

mdl8 = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~isc_r + (1|subject))
summary(mdl6)

mdl9 = lmer(data=data3, z_pupil~isc_r + (1|subject) + (1|story))
summary(mdl7)
```


```{r}
# Individual stories
pool_data <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::filter(story == "Pool Party")

mdl_pool <- lmer(data=pool_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_pool)

billionaire_data <- data3 %>%
  filter(story == "Impatient Billionaire")

mdl_billionaire <- lmer(data=billionaire_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_billionaire)

sea_ice_data <- data3 %>%
  filter(story == "Sea Ice")

mdl_sea_ice <- lmer(data=sea_ice_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_sea_ice)

clocks_data <- data3 %>%
  filter(story == "Grandfather Clocks")

mdl_clocks <- lmer(data=clocks_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_clocks)

dont_look_data <- data3 %>%
  filter(story == "Dont Look")

mdl_dont_look <- lmer(data=dont_look_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_dont_look)

natalie_data <- data3 %>%
  filter(story == "Natalie Wood")

mdl_natalie <- lmer(data=natalie_data, cosine_similarity~z_pupil + (1|subject))
summary(mdl_natalie)


```
